title: Change of heart: Ronnie Liu to stay with DAP for now | The Star
text:
Change of heart: Ronnie Liu to stay with DAP for now | The Star
KLANG: In a surprising turn of events, DAP central working committee member and Sungai Pelek assemblyman Ronnie Liu ( pic ) has decided against ditching his party for now.
Liu, who is a party central executive committee (CEC) member, said in a message posted on his Facebook Timeline, that although he was unhappy and disillusioned with some of his party leaders, he would stay on for the sake of his constituents.
